schedule.note: The Worker executes only on its cron ticks. A stored vendor nextAttemptAt is a backoff deadline and is not an attempt time. `nextAttemptTick` applies the Worker's actual due rule (src/refresh.js `isVendorDue`): a failed vendor is attempted at the first tick at or after the strict deadline, while a vendor with no consecutive failures counts as due up to EARLY_DUE_TOLERANCE_MS (15 min) early, so a deadline seconds after a tick is attempted at that tick. `strictTickAtOrAfterDue` is the deadline-only tick recorded for contrast.
